verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a Webhooks API that delivers real-time HTTP notifications when resources such as Transactions change. It offers full endpoint management (create, update, verify, get, delete), an events endpoint, and a changelog entry adding account balance change subscriptions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and documented detail on the full event-type catalog and signature verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: The Webhooks API allows you to receive real-time HTTP notifications when changes occur to your Mercury resources, like Transactions.
Webhooks (Create/Update/Verify/Get/Delete webhook endpoints); Events (Get all events, Get event by ID).
We've added support for subscribing to account balance change notifications via webhooks and retrieving account balance change events via the events endpoint.
